name: mesh-v4-contracts
description: Mesh V4 covenants (MeshBinV4, PositionManagerV4) on CashScript 0.14 and the BCH 2026 VM. Isolated from the V3 contracts, which stay on cashc 0.12.1.

scripts.build: npm run build:bin && npm run build:variants && npm run build:spikes && npm run build:fixtures
scripts.build:spikes: cashc contracts/spikes/MeshBinP2S.cash -o artifacts/spikes/MeshBinP2S.json && cashc contracts/spikes/BinValidatorV4.cash -o artifacts/spikes/BinValidatorV4.json && cashc contracts/spikes/PositionManagerV4.cash -o artifacts/spikes/PositionManagerV4.json && cashc contracts/spikes/GridProbe.cash -o artifacts/spikes/GridProbe.json && cashc contracts/spikes/MeshBinV4Grid.cash -o artifacts/spikes/MeshBinV4Grid.json
scripts.build:fixtures: cashc test/fixtures/SelfTest.cash -o test/fixtures/SelfTest.json && cashc test/fixtures/ManagerStub.cash -o test/fixtures/ManagerStub.json
scripts.build:variants: cashc contracts/variants/MeshBinV4Locked.cash -o artifacts/variants/MeshBinV4Locked.json && cashc contracts/variants/MeshBinV4Vesting.cash -o artifacts/variants/MeshBinV4Vesting.json && cashc contracts/variants/MeshBinV4FeeSchedule.cash -o artifacts/variants/MeshBinV4FeeSchedule.json && cashc contracts/variants/MeshBinV4SizeFee.cash -o artifacts/variants/MeshBinV4SizeFee.json
